app.name: media-ingest
steps.label: Progress
auth.proxyMissing: The server did not receive a signed-in user from the reverse proxy. Reload the page; if this persists, check the proxy configuration.
login.title: Sign in
setup.title: Setup
setup.intro: A TMDB API key is needed to search for movies and shows. It is stored on the server only and never sent to browsers.
setup.keyLabel: TMDB API key (v3) or read access token (v4)
setup.adminOnly: The server is not configured yet. Ask an administrator to finish the setup.
search.title: What are you adding?
search.label: Title
files.title: Add files
files.dropLabel: Add files: drop them here or press Enter to choose
files.dropHere: Drop files or folders here, or click to choose
files.nothingUploaded: Nothing is uploaded yet. Only names and sizes are read.
map.title: Assign files
map.hintMovie: Pick the main movie file. Several movie files become versions and need distinct labels. Extras and subtitles are optional.
role.subtitle: Subtitle
review.title: Review
review.displayTitleHint: Change it if the metadata title is not what you want on disk. The TMDB id is always kept.
review.folderChoice: Folders with a matching title already exist. Where should the files go?
warning.folder_candidates: {count} existing folder(s) look like this title. Pick one below or create a new folder.
warning.multiple_versions: {count} movie files will be published as versions of one movie.
warning.not_enough_space: There is not enough free space for these files.
warning.conflicts: {count} destination(s) already exist. Choose what to do for each.
upload.title: Upload and publish
upload.wakeOff: Keep this page open and the screen on until uploads finish.
upload.reselect: Select the same files again to continue {n} upload(s). Already uploaded parts are kept.
upload.cancelConfirm: Cancel all unfinished uploads? Files already published stay in the library.
upload.permWarning: Published, but ownership could not be set: {msg}
settings.title: Settings
settings.templateHelp: Variables: {title}, {year}, {id}, {show}, {season:02}, {episode:02}, {episode_end:02}, {episode_title}. Text in <…> is left out when a variable inside is empty. Use {{ and }} for literal braces. The extension is added automatically.
error.network: The server cannot be reached. Check your connection.
error.session_expired: Your session has expired. Reload the page to sign in again.
error.unauthenticated: You are not signed in. Reload the page.
error.csrf: Security check failed. Reload the page.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
error.already_configured: The API key is already configured.
error.provider_not_configured: No TMDB API key is configured yet.
error.provider_unauthorized: TMDB rejected the configured API key.
error.provider_unavailable: TMDB is not reachable right now. Try again later.
error.provider_rate_limited: TMDB is rate limiting requests. Try again in {retryAfter} seconds.
error.internal: Internal server error. Check the server logs.
error.no_movie_file: Choose at least one file as the movie.
error.version_labels_required: Several movie files need different version labels.
error.subtitle_unknown_version: A subtitle refers to a version that does not exist.
error.invalid_subtitle_language: Subtitle language must be a code like en, de or pt-BR.
error.extension_not_allowed: The file type .{ext} is not allowed.
error.invalid_size: A file is empty or larger than the upload limit.
error.duplicate_target: Two files would get the same name ({path}).
error.conflict_policy_required: Choose what to do for every existing destination.
error.role_extension_mismatch: This file type cannot be used in that role.
error.invalid_title: The title cannot be used as a file name.
error.name_too_long: The resulting name is too long.
tv.seasonsHint: Pick every season your files belong to. Specials are Season 0.
tv.episodesInLibrary: {n} episode files already in the library
tv.mapHint: Suggestions come from the file names. Change any of them: pick an episode per file, drag a file onto an episode, or tap “Pick” and then an episode.
tv.noFreeEpisode: Every selected episode is already covered.
tv.existingFiles: Already in the library for this episode:
tv.episodeExists: This episode is already in the library. What should happen?
warning.gaps: Season {season} has missing episodes between your files: {episodes}.
warning.more_files_than_episodes_total: {files} video files but only {episodes} episodes in the selected seasons.
warning.overlapping_episodes: Several files cover the same episode: {episodes}.
warning.alternate_versions: {count} files will be alternate versions of the same episode.
warning.subtitles_without_video: {count} subtitle(s) have no video file and get the default name.
warning.unassigned_files: {count} file(s) not assigned; they will be skipped.
error.alternate_version_required: Two files share an episode. Mark them as alternate versions with different labels, or reassign one.
error.no_episode_file: Assign at least one file to an episode.
error.unknown_season: That season does not exist for this show.
error.folder_reuse_unsupported: The naming template does not allow reusing an existing folder.
search.quickHint: No metadata needed, just copying files into a folder?
quick.title: Where should the files go?
quick.hint: Pick an existing folder under the media root. Files keep their names (illegal characters are replaced).
quick.keepStructure: Keep the folder structure of dropped folders
warning.names_sanitized: {count} file name(s) contained characters that are not allowed and were adjusted.
error.invalid_new_folder: That folder name cannot be used.
error.too_deep: The dropped folders are nested too deeply.
error.invalid_name: A file name cannot be used.
error.missing_at_undo: The file was already gone when undoing.
error.changed_since_publish: The file was changed after publishing, so undo left it in place.
error.not_all_restored: Some replaced files could not be put back because their place is taken; they are still in the trash.
history.title: History
history.hint: Everything you published. Undo moves the published files to the trash and puts back files they had replaced.
history.undoConfirm: Undo “{title}”? {n} published file(s) will be moved to the trash and replaced files restored.
history.undoKept: {n} file(s) were changed after publishing and were left in place.
settings.rulesHint: Rule packs teach the file-name parser other languages. Custom rules run first, then the enabled packs, then the built-in English rules.
settings.customHint: Named groups: season, episode, episodeEnd, specials. No lookarounds or backreferences. More packs can be dropped into the data folder as rules/<name>.yaml.
settings.jellyfinOn: Jellyfin is notified after each batch (JELLYFIN_URL is set).
settings.jellyfinOff: Jellyfin notification is off (set JELLYFIN_URL and JELLYFIN_API_KEY to enable).
